title: Casio Funeral March
prompt: aphex twin style from the druqks album
description: An eerie, sample-collage piece driven by Casio toy-keyboard hits pitched and time-stretched into alien percussion, layered over a slapping jvbass groove and metallic clang hits that cut through the midrange. Eastern melodic fragments drift in and out while a triangle-wave sub traces a slow C minor descent, the whole texture thickening into dense, pitch-smeared chaos before dissolving back into sparse plinks.
code:
setcpm(155/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("casio*4").n("<0 1 2 0>").speed("<1 1.5 0.75 2>").gain(0.85).pan(sine.slow(8).range(0.3,0.7)),
    s("~ metal ~ metal").n("<0 2>").speed(1.5).gain(0.5).room(0.3).hpf(400),
    note("<c2 c2 eb2 g1>").s("triangle").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(200,900)).decay(0.2).sustain(0).gain(0.7)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("casio*8").n("<0 1 2 3 0 2 1 3>").speed("<1 2 0.5 1.5>").gain(0.8).pan(sine.range(0.2,0.8)).degradeBy(0.15),
    s("jvbass*4").n("<0 1>").speed(0.5).gain(0.9).lpf(sine.slow(12).range(300,1400)),
    s("~ metal ~ metal").n("<0 1 2>").speed(2).gain(0.55).room(0.3).hpf(500).delay(0.25),
    note("<c2 c2 eb2 g1>*8").s("triangle").lpf(saw.slow(16).range(300,1800)).resonance(8).decay(0.12).sustain(0).gain(0.75)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("casio*8").n("<0 1 2 3 0 4 1 2>").speed("<1 2 0.5 1.5 0.75 1 2 0.5>").gain(0.85).pan(sine.fast(2).range(0.2,0.8)).sometimesBy(0.2, x => x.speed(2)).every(8, x => x.ply(2)),
    s("jvbass*4").n("<0 1 2>").speed(0.5).gain(0.95).lpf(sine.slow(8).range(400,1600)).shape(0.2),
    s("east*4").n("<0 2 4 1>").speed("<1 0.5 1.5>").gain(0.6).room(0.4).pan(0.6).delay(0.3),
    s("~ metal ~ [metal metal]").n("<0 1 2 3>").speed(2).gain(0.55).hpf(500).delay(0.3).cut(2),

  )],
  [16, stack(
    s("casio*4").n("<0 2 1 3>").speed("<0.75 1 1.5 0.5>").gain(0.7).pan(sine.slow(6).range(0.3,0.7)).room(0.5),
    s("east*2").n("<0 2 4>").speed(0.5).gain(0.6).room(0.6).delay(0.4),
    note("<c2 eb2>").s("triangle").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(200,1000)).decay(0.3).sustain(0).gain(0.65).room(0.4)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("casio*16").n("<0 1 2 3 4 0 1 2>").speed("<1 2 0.5 1.5 0.75 2 1 0.5>").gain(0.85).pan(perlin.range(0.1,0.9)).degradeBy(0.1).every(4, x => x.ply("<1 2>")).sometimesBy(0.25, x => x.speed(4)),
    s("jvbass*8").n("<0 1 2 3>").speed(0.5).gain(0.95).lpf(sine.slow(8).range(500,1800)).shape(0.25),
    s("east*4").n("<0 2 4 6 1 3>").speed("<1 0.5 1.5 2>").gain(0.6).room(0.4).delay(0.3).pan(sine.range(0.3,0.7)),
    s("metal*4").n("<0 1 2 3>").speed(2).gain(0.5).hpf(600).delay(0.3).cut(2).degradeBy(0.3),
    note("<c3 eb3 g2 bb2 ab2 g2>*8").s("triangle").lpf(saw.slow(16).range(500,2800)).resonance(12).decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.7).off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.4))
  )],
  [16, stack(

    s("~ metal ~ metal").n("<0 1>").speed(1.5).gain(0.45).room(0.4).hpf(400).delay(0.3),
